This dataset contains agent execution trajectories for MemGUI-Bench, a comprehensive memory-centric benchmark for mobile GUI agents presented in the paper MemGUI-Bench: Benchmarking Memory of Mobile GUI Agents in Dynamic Environments.

	
		
		Introduction
